name: single leg calf raise (on a dumbbell)
description: Standing on one leg, you rise up onto your toes with the ball of your foot on a dumbbell. Works the calves with extra range.
instructions: Place a dumbbell on the floor next to a support and stand with the ball of one foot on its handle.
Hold the support with one hand and bend your other leg behind you.
Lower your heel toward the floor for a stretch.
Rise as high as you can onto the ball of your foot.
Lower slowly, finish your reps, then switch legs.
